title: Coral and the Terminal
author: Y. M. Fairweather
blurb: Ines Vasquez, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
